gold_mine.name: Gold Mine
gold_mine.description: A shaft plunges into darkness without visible end, pickaxe ringing day and night. Seen through the morning mist, the miners' hunched silhouettes look like ants crawling across the earth—every grain of gold soaked in sweat.

lumber_mill.name: Lumber Mill
lumber_mill.description: The toothed blade bites into the trunk with a piercing shriek, fresh sawdust flying like snow. The air is thick with pine resin; wood chips pile into small hills—every plank carries the memory of being torn.

quarry.name: Quarry
quarry.description: The rhythm of hammer blows echoes through the valley. Granite blocks are chiseled free, their faces still bearing the scars of iron wedges. Stone dust hangs like fog; the workers cough up white.

iron_mine.name: Iron Mine
iron_mine.description: The entrance rock is stained deep rust-red; rain washes it into brown-red tear tracks across the ground. Ore carts rumble out of the tunnel, dumping their load of dark-red hope.

copper_mine.name: Copper Mine
copper_mine.description: Water seeping from the tunnel walls carries a blue-green sheen, like tears from ancient stars. Ore is crushed, ground—the earth's skin peeled back to reveal the emerald luster beneath.

aluminum_mine.name: Aluminum Mine
aluminum_mine.description: Chalk-white tailings pile into hills that look like snow that will never melt. Machines chew through rust-red bauxite, spitting out light silver powder—the weight of the sky, almost within reach.

coal_mine.name: Coal Mine
coal_mine.description: Black dust coats everything—the workers' faces, the shed roofs, every leaf for a hundred meters. Only the whites of their eyes remain, flickering like ghosts at the mouth of the deep shaft.

oil_well.name: Oil Well
oil_well.description: Steel derricks rise and fall against the twilight, rhythmic as some great breathing beast. A deep, muffled rumble rolls up from below; viscous crude flows through pipelines toward an unknown destination.

crystal_mine.name: Crystal Mine
crystal_mine.description: The cavern walls glitter with hexagonal prisms. When the headlamp sweeps across them, the entire tunnel becomes a flowing galaxy. The diggers move carefully—beautiful things shatter easily.

farm.name: Farm
farm.description: Wind chases golden waves across the wheat fields; a silent scarecrow keeps watch over the horizon. At dusk, cooking smoke rises, the sweetness of earth mingling with the warm scent of livestock—the settlement's last corner still at peace with the land.

iron_smelter.name: Iron Smelter
iron_smelter.description: The furnace mouth vomits orange-red fire, the heat palpable from hundreds of meters away. Molten iron pours like lava into the molds, hissing clouds of white steam—raw, naked transformation.

copper_smelter.name: Copper Smelter
copper_smelter.description: Copper liquid swirls in rose-colored eddies inside the crucible, the air carrying a faint sweet metallic tang. As it cools, dark-purple oxidation blooms across the ingot's surface—like frozen sunset.

chemical_plant.name: Chemical Plant
chemical_plant.description: Tangled pipework sprawls like a giant's digestive system, silver distillation towers glinting in the sun. A sharp acidic scent hangs in the air; workers hurry past in masks—every hiss of venting steam tenses the shoulders.

steel_mill.name: Steel Mill
steel_mill.description: The rolling mill's roar could shatter windowpanes; glowing red slabs are pressed, stretched, flattened. When the cooling water hits, the entire building vanishes into a whiteout—a man-made thunderstorm indoors.

glass_factory.name: Glass Factory
glass_factory.description: Quartz sand melts into amber-hued syrup inside the furnace; blowpipes rotate and transparent bubbles swell like life itself. Finished panes stacked in the sun throw dancing rainbows across the floor.

plastic_factory.name: Plastic Factory
plastic_factory.description: The extruder spits out an endless white strand, cooled and chopped into neat pellets. The whole factory smells faintly of new shoes—the scent of carbon chains being rearranged.

circuit_board_factory.name: Circuit Board Factory
circuit_board_factory.description: Inside green-lit cleanrooms, robotic arms solder at speeds the eye cannot follow. Everything happens in silence—this is the settlement's cerebral cortex being assembled.

motor_factory.name: Motor Factory
motor_factory.description: Copper wire winders hum a steady rhythm, weaving electromagnetic webs around core after core. On the test bench, freshly assembled motors spin lightly—industrial civilization's pulse starts here.

sensor_factory.name: Sensor Factory
sensor_factory.description: Gowned workers drift through sterile rooms like astronauts. Micron-scale silicon wafers are sculpted under microscopes—a single sensor is more sensitive than dust, more precise than a hawk's eye.

gear_factory.name: Gear Factory
gear_factory.description: The milling cutter bites into the steel billet, spraying a waterfall of blue-white sparks. Gears are ground, quenched, calibrated one by one—the gaps between interlocking teeth measured to a hundredth of a hair.

battery_factory.name: Battery Factory
battery_factory.description: Lithium-cobalt powder churns into black slurry inside small vats, then coats silver foil. Every battery is a chemical prison quietly awaiting release.

generator_factory.name: Generator Factory
generator_factory.description: Giant coils rotate slowly on the winding machine; copper bars are bent into flawless arcs. The finished units are encased in shipping-container-sized shells—they will roar as they turn steel rotation into civilizational blood.

chip_fab.name: Chip Fabrication Plant
chip_fab.description: In spaces a thousand times cleaner than an operating room, ultraviolet light etches nanometer-scale cities onto silicon wafers. A single speck of dust can ruin the entire wafer—this is humanity's precision engineering at its apex.

quantum_lab.name: Quantum Computing Center
quantum_lab.description: Deep-blue cryostats stand like altars; quantum chips compute in the silence of -273°C. Equations streak across the monitors like comets—a human here is merely a spectator.

robot_factory.name: Robot Factory
robot_factory.description: At the end of the assembly line, robots are building their own offspring. Jointed arms rotate, dock, and lock with balletic precision. When the final bolt is tightened, the newborn robot opens its eyes.

nanobot_factory.name: Nanobot Factory
nanobot_factory.description: Nothing moves visible to the naked eye—only the electron microscope feed shows the truth: hundreds of millions of tiny machines self-assembling, crawling across molecular surfaces, ferrying atoms into place one by one.

antimatter_reactor.name: Antimatter Reactor
antimatter_reactor.description: Points of light race through the ring-shaped pipe at near-light speed, held by invisible magnetic hands. A faint blue glow persists—the last echo of matter and antimatter annihilating each other.

time_crystal_synth.name: Time Crystal Synthesizer
time_crystal_synth.description: A ring of lasers fires at a single point with impossible precision. Where the beams converge, spacetime ripples faintly—and occasionally, a grain falls out, already pulsing backward through time before it has finished cooling.

maggot_trough.name: Maggot Breeding Trough
maggot_trough.description: In the warm, humid chamber held at 38 degrees, flesh rots slowly while maggot colonies churn across it like boiling porridge. The stench is sealed behind reinforced glass—but nobody lingers long enough to look.

maggot_factory.name: Maggot Factory
maggot_factory.description: Conveyor belts feed tons of biological waste into incubation chambers; maggots multiply frantically in heated darkness. Machines harvest, wash, and dry them at 3,000 per minute—then package them for unnamed downstream facilities.

necrotic_pool.name: Necrotic Recycling Pool
necrotic_pool.description: Dark-green slime burbles thickly, its stench sharp enough to sting tears from your eyes. Peer over the edge and pale things writhe slowly in the depths—occasionally surfacing, then sinking again.

symbiotic_chamber.name: Symbiotic Breeding Chamber
symbiotic_chamber.description: Tanks filled with pale-blue nutrient fluid hold naked human bodies curled like fetuses. Maggots line the grooves of the spine, establishing connections with the host's nerve endings—EEG patterns on the monitors slowly overlap.

neural_spire.name: Neural Spire
neural_spire.description: The spire's tip pierces the clouds, radiating invisible psionic pulses from its summit. Every symbiont's consciousness converges here, resonating—fueling the extraction of dark matter from the void, using thought itself as raw material.

deep_space_hatchery.name: Deep Space Hatchery
deep_space_hatchery.description: The orbital drydock rotates slowly among the stars, arc-welders flickering like miniature lightning. The skeleton of a colony ship is being assembled segment by segment—in this boundless dark, the settlement is building itself a new cradle.
